title: these afternoons saved my life
text:
it's a sunny day, and
i don't really know what to say to you anymore
it's been so long and i've changed and you've changed
and the river's not the same either
warm afternoons have new faces
i'm so caught up learning them
giving them a spin,
listening to their voices
i can barely remember yours
saying anything other than your "catchphrases"
how could this have washed away?
i thought a landscape was forever
a picture was forever
but a moss has grown there
and my memory grows weary
